```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
## Rendered by target `report_output_differences` (R/targets_report04.R) from the data that
## build_report04_data() (R/report04_data.R) puts in target `report04Data`; rendered by hand,
## `data_file` can name an .rds of the same list instead. execute-dir is the project root.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
library(targets)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(kableExtra)
source("R/report05_helpers.R")
source("R/report04_helpers.R")

rd <- if (nzchar(params$data_file)) readRDS(params$data_file) else tar_read(report04Data)

fig_dir <- file.path("outputs", "_reports", "figures", "04-output-differences")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
## absolute paths: knitr::knit_child() leaves the working directory at reports/
fig_dir <- normalizePath(fig_dir)
tenure_child <- normalizePath("reports/_04-tenure.qmd")
knit_child_here <- function(...) {
  owd <- getwd()
  on.exit(setwd(owd), add = TRUE)
  knitr::knit_child(...)
}
ha <- report05_ha
pct <- report05_pct
signed1 <- report04_signed
slug <- function(x) gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", tolower(x))
## "a", "a and b", "a, b and c"
and_list <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) < 2L) x else paste(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), "and", x[[length(x)]])
}
vlab <- c(v2 = "version 2", v3 = "version 3")
## the age classes, youngest first, and their labels
ac <- rd$age_classes
age_lab <- report05_age_class_labels(rd$age_classes, rd$age_cutoffs)

ten <- rd$tenures[order(name)]
n_ten <- nrow(ten)
n_runs <- uniqueN(ten$run)
n_sa <- uniqueN(ten$study_area)
n_v3_tenures <- nrow(LandWebUtils::tenureShortNames())
name_of <- function(t) ten$name[match(t, ten$tenure)]

## simulation design, by version
des <- rd$design[,
  .(n = .N, reps = uniqueN(rep), first = min(time), last = max(time), step = min(diff(sort(unique(time))))),
  by = .(tenure, version)
]
des_v <- unique(des[, .(version, n, reps, first, last, step)])
one_design <- function(v) {
  d <- des_v[version == v]
  if (nrow(d) != 1L) NULL else d
}
pixel_v2 <- unique(rd$runs[setting == "pixel_m", value])
pixel_v3 <- unique(vapply(rd$sources, function(s) s$pixel_m, numeric(1)))
disp <- rd$runs[setting == "dispersal", .(tenure, value)]

## reporting boundaries
bs <- as.data.table(rd$boundary_stats)
bs[, name := name_of(tenure)]
cmp <- bs[is.na(reason)]
abs_change <- abs(cmp$pct_change)

## all forest by age class, both versions
all_long <- rd$pct_type[vegType == "All species"]
all_delta <- rd$delta_type[vegType == "All species"]

## composition: each version's simulated median share of forest against its own current share
comp <- rd$pct_share[!is.na(cc) & n > 0L]
comp[, dep := 100 * (p50 - cc)]
comp_types <- intersect(c("Fir", "Decid", "Pine", "Bl_Spruce", "Wh_Spruce", "Doug_fir", "Mixed"), unique(comp$vegType))
## per version and type: tenures, and those simulated above their current share
comp_count <- comp[, .(n = .N, above = sum(dep > 0), median_dep = stats::median(dep)), by = .(version, vegType)]

## old forest in large patches
patch_long <- rd$pct_patch
patch_delta <- rd$delta_patch
```

# Summary {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| output: asis
old_up <- all_delta[ageClass == ac[[length(ac)]]]
young_up <- all_delta[ageClass == ac[[1L]]]
cnt <- function(v, t) comp_count[version == v & vegType == t]
cat(
  sprintf(
    "This report compares the simulated outputs of LandWeb version 2, the model behind the 2020 and 2021 reports to the partners, with those of version 3, for the %d tenures that both versions simulated.",
    n_ten
  ),
  sprintf(
    "Version 2 simulated each tenure or licensee area on its own, in %d runs; version 3 simulates groups of tenures that share an ecoregion, and these tenures fall in %d of its study-area groups.",
    n_runs, n_sa
  ),
  sprintf(
    "Of the %d tenures that version 3 reports on, the other %d have no version 2 run.",
    n_v3_tenures, n_v3_tenures - n_ten
  ),
  "",
  sprintf(
    "The reporting boundaries changed between the versions: %d of the %d tenures compared kept their area to within 1%%, %d changed by 1 to 10%% and %d by more than 10%% (@sec-boundaries).",
    sum(abs_change < 1), nrow(cmp), sum(abs_change >= 1 & abs_change <= 10), sum(abs_change > 10)
  ),
  sprintf(
    "The simulated median share of all forest that is %s is higher in version 3 than in version 2 in %d of %d tenures, and the share that is %s in %d (@sec-age).",
    tolower(ac[[length(ac)]]), sum(old_up$d_p50 > 0), nrow(old_up),
    tolower(ac[[1L]]), sum(young_up$d_p50 > 0)
  ),
  unlist(lapply(intersect(c("Fir", "Decid"), comp_types), function(t) {
    if (nrow(cnt("v2", t)) && nrow(cnt("v3", t))) {
      sprintf(
        "Version 2 simulated more %s-leading forest than the current condition holds in %d of %d tenures, and version 3 in %d of %d (@sec-composition).",
        tolower(report05_veg_label(t)), cnt("v2", t)$above, cnt("v2", t)$n, cnt("v3", t)$above, cnt("v3", t)$n
      )
    }
  })),
  sep = "\n"
)
```

# Introduction

LandWeb version 3 rebuilds the model's data preparation and orchestration, updates its inputs, and changes a few of its rules; reports 01 to 03 of this series describe those changes.
This report shows what they do to the outputs: it sets the version 2 results beside the version 3 results for each tenure that both versions simulated, using the metrics of the 2021 reports.
Report 05 gives the version 3 results for each study-area group in full.

The comparison covers, for each tenure:

- the reporting boundary;
- the share of forest in each age class, for all forest and for each vegetation type, as box plots and percentile tables;
- the area of old forest in large patches, as histograms;
- the share of forest that each vegetation type leads, which tests whether version 3 repeats a problem the 2021 reports describe in version 2's vegetation dynamics.

Each version is compared with its own current condition, the red circles and lines in the figures, because the two versions start from different maps of today's forest.

# How the comparison is made

## Matching version 2 runs to version 3 tenures

Version 2 ran one study area per tenure or licensee and summarised each of its tenure polygons; version 3 reports by tenure, using the boundaries of an updated FMA map.
Each version 2 polygon was matched to the version 3 tenure it overlaps, by area, not by name: tenures have changed hands since version 2 was run, so a name can point to a different tenure.
The matches are listed in @tbl-crosswalk.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-crosswalk
#| tbl-cap: "The version 2 polygon compared with each version 3 tenure, where the names differ or the version 2 run covered several tenures. The run of each tenure is in Appendix B."
cwp <- rd$crosswalk[primary == TRUE & tenure %in% ten$tenure]
cwp[, name := name_of(tenure)]
## the tenures each version 2 layer reported on, whichever of them it is compared for
n_layer <- rd$crosswalk[, .(n_in_layer = .N), by = .(run, layer)]
cwp <- merge(cwp, n_layer, by = c("run", "layer"))
cw_show <- cwp[name != zone | n_in_layer > 1L][order(name)]
kbl(
  cw_show[, .(`Version 3 tenure` = name, `Version 2 polygon` = zone, `Tenures in the version 2 run` = n_in_layer)],
  format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, align = "llr"
) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"), font_size = 8)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
## tenures that another version 2 run also reported on
alt <- rd$crosswalk[primary == FALSE & tenure %in% ten$tenure]
alt <- alt[run != cwp$run[match(tenure, cwp$tenure)]]
if (nrow(alt)) {
  cat(
    sprintf(
      "%d %s reported on by more than one version 2 run: %s.",
      uniqueN(alt$tenure), if (uniqueN(alt$tenure) == 1L) "tenure was" else "tenures were",
      sub("[.]$", "", and_list(sort(name_of(unique(alt$tenure)))))
    ),
    "Each is compared with one of them: the run that reported on that tenure alone where there is one, and otherwise the run named for the tenure's first-listed licensee (Appendix B).",
    sep = "\n"
  )
  cat("\n")
}
## version 2 polygons that are not a tenure (parts of a compared tenure are listed in Appendix B only)
um <- rd$unmatched[!startsWith(reason, "part of")]
if (nrow(um)) {
  cat(
    "",
    sprintf(
      "Version 2 also reported on %s, which version 3 does not compare: %s.",
      and_list(um$zone), paste(um$reason, collapse = "; ")
    ),
    sep = "\n"
  )
}
```

## Simulation design {#sec-design}

```{r}
#| output: asis
d2 <- one_design("v2")
d3 <- one_design("v3")
design_sentence <- function(d, v, px) {
  if (is.null(d)) {
    return(sprintf("The number of simulated landscapes differs between the tenures in %s (Appendix B).", vlab[[v]]))
  }
  sprintf(
    "In %s, each tenure's results summarise %d simulated landscapes: %d replicate simulations, each sampled every %d years from year %d to year %d, on a %s m grid.",
    vlab[[v]], d$n, d$reps, d$step, d$first, d$last, paste(px, collapse = " or ")
  )
}
cat(
  design_sentence(d2, "v2", pixel_v2),
  design_sentence(d3, "v3", pixel_v3),
  "Box plots and percentiles therefore rest on different numbers of landscapes in the two versions, and the version 3 landscapes within a replicate are closer together in time.",
  sprintf(
    "Version 2 used one of two seed-dispersal settings, recorded in each run's name: high dispersal for %d of these tenures and aspen dispersal for %d.",
    sum(disp$value == "high"), sum(disp$value == "aspen")
  ),
  sep = "\n"
)
```

What the two version 2 seed-dispersal settings were, and how they compare with version 3's seed dispersal.

## Metrics

Both versions are measured with the same rules, as in the 2021 reports and report 05.

- Age classes: `r paste(tolower(age_lab), collapse = "; ")`.
- Vegetation type: the leading species group of a stand, or mixedwood; the rule that assigns a stand its type changed (report 03, "Leading-species threshold" and "Mixedwood is now judged on the broadleaf group").
- Old-forest patch results: the total area of old forest, all types combined, in patches of at least `r and_list(ha(sort(unique(rd$patch_nrv$min_patch_ha))))` ha.
- The percentiles of both versions are computed the same way, from each version's simulated landscapes.

## Changes between the versions {#sec-changes}

@tbl-changes lists the changes that can move the outputs compared here, and where each is described.
This report does not separate their effects.

| Change | Described in | What it changes in the model |
|---|---|---|
| Tenure reporting boundaries (updated FMA map) | @sec-boundaries | The area each value is computed over |
| Starting forest: species cover, biomass and stand ages | Report 01 | The current condition and the forest the simulations start from |
| Long-term fire cycle map | Report 02 | The area burned, and so the time since fire that sets the age classes |
| Leading-species threshold and mixedwood rule | Report 03 | The vegetation type each stand is given |
| Regeneration after fire | Report 03 | Which species regrow after a fire |
| Species simulated on their own and their traits | Report 03 | The species behind each vegetation type |
| Seed-dispersal setting of the version 2 runs | @sec-design (not yet in report 03) | Where seed-regenerating species can establish |
| Number and spacing of simulated landscapes; grid size | @sec-design | How many landscapes each box summarises; the cells patches are built from |

: Changes between version 2 and version 3 that can move the outputs compared in this report. {#tbl-changes}

## Forest composition and the version 2 succession problem {#sec-composition}

The 2021 reports tested version 2 against an assumption made at the start of the project: that the average share of each vegetation type in the simulated landscapes should be close to its share today [@Andison:2021pembina, section 6.6.1].
Version 2 failed that test, replacing conifer species with pioneer hardwood species and fir at a rate the authors judged unrealistic.
The short-term fix was to make every species resprout after fire, which emulates a state-transition model; the reports note that this still produced some unlikely shifts in vegetation type.
Version 3 drops that fix (report 03, "Regeneration after fire").

@fig-composition compares, for each tenure, the simulated median share of forest that each type leads with the type's share in the same version's current condition.

```{r}
#| output: asis
type_line <- function(t) {
  a <- cnt("v2", t)
  b <- cnt("v3", t)
  if (!nrow(a) || !nrow(b)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  sprintf(
    "%s: simulated above the current share in %d of %d tenures in version 2 (median departure %s percentage points) and in %d of %d in version 3 (%s).",
    report05_veg_label(t), a$above, a$n, signed1(a$median_dep), b$above, b$n, signed1(b$median_dep)
  )
}
cat(unlist(lapply(comp_types, type_line)), sep = "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-composition
#| fig-cap: "Simulated median share of forest led by each vegetation type minus its share in the current condition, by tenure, in version 2 (blue) and version 3 (green). Positive values mean the simulations hold more of the type than the forest does today."
#| fig-height: !expr 1.2 + 0.26 * n_ten
#| fig-width: 6.5
d <- comp[vegType %in% comp_types][, name := name_of(tenure)]
d[, facet := factor(report05_veg_label(vegType), levels = report05_veg_label(comp_types))]
p <- report04_departure_plot(d)
report05_save_png(p, fig_dir, "composition_departure", 6.5, 1.2 + 0.26 * n_ten)
p
```

::: {.callout-note}

:::

# Results by tenure

## Reading the figures

Each tenure's box plots summarise the simulated landscapes of both versions, version 2 in blue and version 3 in green.
The box spans the middle half of the values (25th to 75th percentile), the line inside it is the median, the whiskers reach the most extreme values within one and a half box lengths, and the dots beyond them are the rarer values.
Each set of boxes covers the age classes of one vegetation type, in the simulated landscapes where that type leads some of the forest; in each of those landscapes, the shares of the age classes add up to all of that type's forest.
The red circle beside each box is that version's current condition.
The histograms show the area of old forest in large patches across the simulated landscapes of each version, with that version's current condition as a red line.

# Appendix A: Percentile tables {.unnumbered}

For each tenure, the tables give the current share of forest in each age class and the percentiles of the simulated shares, in percent, by vegetation type, for both versions.
The percentiles summarise the simulated landscapes in which the type leads some forest, whose number is in the column "Landscapes"; a dash marks a type that never leads in that version's simulations.
Percentiles by ecological sub-region are not compared yet.

```{r}
#| output: asis
pcols <- c("min", "p12.5", "p25", "p50", "p75", "p87.5", "max")
pnames <- c("Min", "12.5", "25", "50", "75", "87.5", "Max")
pct_or_dash <- function(x) fifelse(is.na(x), "--", pct(x))
for (i in seq_len(n_ten)) {
  t <- ten$tenure[i]
  d <- copy(rd$pct_type[tenure == t])
  d[, type := report05_veg_label(vegType)]
  d[, key := fifelse(vegType == "All species", "0", type)]
  d[, ageClass := factor(ageClass, levels = ac)]
  d[, (pcols) := lapply(.SD, pct_or_dash), .SDcols = pcols]
  d[, cc := fifelse(is.na(cc), "--", pct(cc))]
  setorderv(d, c("key", "ageClass", "version"))
  d[, show := fifelse(seq_len(.N) == 1L, type, ""), by = key]
  d[, age := fifelse(seq_len(.N) == 1L, as.character(ageClass), ""), by = .(key, ageClass)]
  out <- d[, c("show", "age", "version", "cc", "n", pcols), with = FALSE]
  out[, version := sub("^v", "", version)]
  setnames(out, c("Vegetation type", "Age class", "Version", "Current", "Landscapes", pnames))
  cat(
    kbl(
      out,
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      longtable = TRUE,
      caption = sprintf("A1. %s: share of each vegetation type's forest by age class, versions 2 and 3.", sub("[.]$", "", ten$name[i])),
      align = c("l", "l", "c", rep("r", 9L)),
      linesep = c("", "\\addlinespace"),
      label = NA
    ) |>
      add_header_above(c(" " = 5, "Simulated percentiles (%)" = 7)) |>
      kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "repeat_header"), font_size = 7)
  )
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# Appendix B: Data and code {.unnumbered}

This report was built from the LandWeb v3 `targets` pipeline on `r rd$built`.

- Report data: target `report04Data` (`build_report04_data()`, `R/report04_data.R`), from one target per study-area group, `report04Tenures_<group>` (`build_report04_sa()`).
- Version 3 values: NRV_summary's parquet datasets under `outputs/<group>/postprocess/_aggregates/` (`lw_FMA` and `lw_FMA_CC`; metrics `leadingProp`, `leadingShare` and `totalArea_ge<size>ha`), read as report 05 reads them; area simulated as forest from the current-condition vegetation-type map in `_reportingMaps/`.
- Version 2 values: each run's summary files under `outputs_v2/<run>/` (`boxplots/leading_<layer>.csv`, `histograms/largePatches_<layer>_<size>.csv`), and for the share of forest by vegetation type today, the run's current-condition maps (`CurrentConditionVTM`, `CurrentConditionTSF.tif`).
  Read back over each version 2 polygon, those maps reproduce the current-condition age-class shares that version 2 saved to within `r format(signif(100 * max(rd$checks$v2_cc_map_vs_saved, na.rm = TRUE), 2))` percentage points.
- Version 2 area simulated as forest: the mean, over the simulated landscapes, of the forest pixels in each polygon.
- Matching of version 2 polygons to version 3 tenures: `v2_v3_crosswalk()` and `v2_unmatched()` in `R/fma_boundary_change.R`; run directories by `v2_run_dir()`, which takes `<run>_highDispersal_logROS`, else `<run>_aspenDispersal_logROS`.
- Reporting-boundary comparison: `fma_boundary_compare()` (`R/fma_boundary_change.R`), against the version 2 runs' `ml_preamble.rds`.
- Standalone copies of the figures: `` `r report05_relpath(fig_dir)` ``.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-runs
#| tbl-cap: "Version 2 run, polygon, area simulated as forest in each version, and the date of the version 2 summary files, by tenure."
when <- rd$runs[setting == "summaries_written", .(tenure, when = value)]
rt <- merge(ten, when, by = "tenure", all.x = TRUE)[order(name), .(
  Tenure = name,
  Code = tenure,
  `Group (v3)` = study_area,
  `Run (v2)` = basename(run_dir),
  `Layer (v2)` = layer,
  `Forest v2 (ha)` = ha(forest_v2_ha),
  `Forest v3 (ha)` = ha(forest_v3_ha),
  `v2 summaries` = when
)]
kbl(rt, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "repeat_header"), font_size = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-not-compared
#| tbl-cap: "Version 2 runs and polygons that are not compared: other runs that reported on a compared tenure, and polygons that are not a version 3 tenure."
nc_alt <- rd$crosswalk[primary == FALSE & tenure %in% cwp$tenure, .(
  Polygon = zone,
  Run = run,
  Layer = layer,
  Why = sprintf("%s is compared from run %s, layer %s", tenure, cwp$run[match(tenure, cwp$tenure)], cwp$layer[match(tenure, cwp$tenure)])
)]
nc_um <- rd$unmatched[, .(Polygon = zone, Run = run, Layer = layer, Why = reason)]
kbl(rbind(nc_alt, nc_um), format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"), font_size = 7)
```
